core_obligations: Build the cartesian diagram from a surjective etale V -> Y and a surjective etale U -> X x_Y V and record that the left vertical arrow is surjective etale and the right vertical arrow is etale (proof lines 7737-7758).
Assume f unramified, apply the scheme case to U -> V to make Delta_{U/V} an open immersion, and conclude that Delta_{X/Y} is an etale morphism by locality of etaleness (proof lines 7761-7767).
Deduce that Delta_{X/Y} is a representable etale monomorphism, hence an open immersion, and translate between the functorial and the scheme language (proof lines 7768-7774).
Conversely assume f locally of finite type and Delta_{X/Y} an open immersion, and conclude that Delta_{U/V} is etale as a morphism between schemes etale over X x_Y X (proof lines 7777-7784).
Use that Delta_{U/V} is in any case an immersion to make it an open immersion, conclude that U -> V is unramified, and hence that f is unramified by definition (proof lines 7785-7791).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S, unramifiedness of f is equivalent to the diagonal Delta_{X/Y} : X -> X x_Y X being an open immersion, the second direction under the extra assumption that f is locally of finite type (source lines 7724-7734). The proof works with the cartesian square built from surjective etale V -> Y and U -> X x_Y V: it first records that the diagonal is always a representable monomorphism and that the middle vertical arrow is etale, then in one direction uses the scheme case for U -> V together with locality of etaleness on the source to make Delta_{X/Y} a representable etale monomorphism and hence an open immersion, and in the other direction uses that the diagonal of a morphism of schemes is an immersion to upgrade etaleness of Delta_{U/V} to an open immersion and conclude unramifiedness of U -> V and then of f.
